summary: Information technology specialist with over two decades of hands-on experience across network infrastructure, end-user support, and systems administration in education and enterprise environments. Has progressed from junior network administration to senior network support and a long-running IT specialist role, covering LAN/WAN configuration, routers, switches, DHCP, Active Directory, and server support. Brings multi-platform desktop management in Windows and macOS, software deployment and imaging, license and vendor management, network monitoring, and video conferencing systems. Holds CompTIA A+, Network+, and Security+ certifications along with CCNA and MCSE credentials, and is oriented toward network and systems roles with growing information systems and security responsibilities.
